row.evidence: TalentLMS documents SCIM v2 user and group provisioning ("Currently, TalentLMS only supports SCIM provisioning through Okta and Azure AD"), but neither the pricing page nor the plan feature PDF names the plan that includes it.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. SCIM is documented but no plan gate is published; SSO (SAML2.0, LDAP, OpenID Connect) is listed on every paid plan from Core and SCIM requires SSO, so SCIM is likely Core+ but that is not stated (rule 1a: unknown). Plans are flat monthly prices per active-user bracket (Core $119/mo for 1-40 users billed yearly, Grow $229/mo for 1-70, Pro $449/mo for 1-100 + $6/extra user, Enterprise contact sales); per-user fields left null. SCIM works only with Okta and Entra ID (custom app); deactivation sets the user inactive. REST API v2 on all paid plans.

auth.token_source: Account & Settings > Users > Single Sign-on (SSO) > Enable SCIM v2 user provisioning; SCIM key shown in the SSO form
auth.notes: Okta app uses Authentication Mode HTTP Header with the SCIM key; Entra uses it as Secret Token. 'bearer' is inferred from the Entra secret-token flow.

operations.notes: Docs say profile updates sync but do not say whether PUT or PATCH is used. Group push via SCIM added in July 2026 (V7.1); with Okta only on a custom SCIM app, not the OIN TalentLMS app.

deprovision.data_retained: Account is set from active to inactive and is not deleted.

custom.how: Pick TalentLMS custom user fields in the SSO settings, enable 'SCIM v2 custom fields provisioning', and create an IdP SCIM attribute with the exact (case-sensitive) field name.

attributes.notes: Docs name username, email, user type and time zone; no full schema is published. Time zone attribute name not given.

roles.how: userType attribute maps to TalentLMS user types (roles); default user type applies when not sent

limitations.text: SCIM is supported only through Okta and Azure AD (Entra ID).
SSO must be configured before SCIM can be enabled.
Okta group push and group memberships only work with a custom Okta SSO application, not the default TalentLMS Okta app.
Entra provisioning uses a custom non-gallery Enterprise application.
Branch group matching requires groups already associated with the branch.
Deleted users are archived first; re-provisioning a user with the same email fails until the old user is permanently deleted.

endpoints.purpose: Update a user (incl. active flag and user_type_id)
Archive a user, or permanently delete with permanent=true
Add a user to a group
Remove a user from a group
Platform events and user activity timeline

audit_log_api.notes: GET /api/v2/timeline returns platform events and user activities (c47); it is not described as an audit log.

rate_limits.text: Help centre: 200 API calls per 5 seconds. Developer hub: rate and usage limits, e.g. 2000 requests per hour.

limitations.text: API not available on the Free plan or during the free trial.

okta.notes: OIN page ticks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Sync Password (Group Push not ticked).

entra.notes: Gallery app is SSO only; TalentLMS documents SCIM through a custom non-gallery Entra app (c26).

fallbacks.other_sync: HRIS integrations listed in the features PDF (ADP, Sage People, BambooHR, Workday beta); Salesforce, Shopify, Zapier.
